title: Calendrum conformance expected fingerprints (expected.fingerprints.json)
description: Component fingerprints of input.ics with the default fingerprint options, in input order.

calendarIndex.description: The VCALENDAR the component belongs to, from 0; -1 for a top-level component outside any VCALENDAR.

uid.description: UID of the component, null for VTIMEZONE and for components keyed by ordinal.

recurrenceId.description: Raw RECURRENCE-ID value next to a UID, otherwise null.

tzid.description: TZID of a VTIMEZONE, otherwise null.

ordinal.description: Position among components of the same name without a UID (TZID for VTIMEZONE) in the same VCALENDAR, from 0; -1 for a keyed component.

hash.description: xxHash64 of the canonical component text, 16 lowercase hex digits.

startOffset.description: Offset of the BEGIN line in UTF-8 bytes from the start of the input (of the decoded text for a transcoded input).

endOffset.description: Offset just after the END line and its line ending, or where the component was closed implicitly.
